selection_basis: Remaining S&P SmallCap 600 issuers by official SPSM holding weight after the rows used by additional-300-mdy-spsm-2026-11-04-r1 (same holdings file, SHA-256 checked), with SEC Company Facts snapshots, after SEC (company_tickers_exchange) and Nasdaq Trader listing identity checks. Fund holdings are a selection basis, not an index-membership certification. SPSM gives no sectors: each sector is the one held by tracked companies with the same SEC SIC description, reviewed per company and corrected to the issuer GICS sector where they differ (sector_basis); uncertain assignments are flagged.
